headline: Trump administration sued over new Canadian tariffs
summary: A new lawsuit challenges the White House's authority to impose trade tariffs on Canada, arguing the measures cause immediate harm to American businesses.
why: Trade tariffs directly impact cross-border supply chains, manufacturing costs, and corporate profit margins for companies reliant on international trade.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Tariff disputes introduce regulatory uncertainty and input cost inflation for import-reliant businesses.
